{{Quote|But sometimes-- when you ''believe'' in something enough-- you do it anyway.''"<br />"''E-even if everyone else says you ''can't''...? That it's ''impossible...?"<br />"''Maybe ''especially'' then.|Leia Organa and Tammia Hollusen|<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 30" />}}
'''Tammia Hollusen''', also known as '''Tammi''', was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] who, in her youth, lived and worked for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] on [[Metalorn/Legends|Metalorn]]. She aided in Princess [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa's]] escape from [[Orman Tagge/Legends|Orman Tagge]]. Tammi planted a single flower on Metalorn to show the first seeds of rebellion to the Empire.

Hollusen eventually joined the [[Peace Brigade]], but ultimately left the group. Hollusen had become the leader of Metalorn by [[32 ABY/Legends|32 ABY]], when Leia Organa Solo returned to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] to conduct peace negotiations with Hollusen.<ref name="AC9" />
